Settings.ModelDescription: Local Gemma model used for LLM processing. Save keeps your choice; use Download and load model to fetch it (several gigabytes) and load it.
Settings.StreamResponsesDescription: Render prompt-action output token-by-token as the local model generates it, instead of waiting for the full reply.
Settings.ModelReadyLoadsOnUse: Model ready. It is not in memory now and loads on its next use.
Settings.ModelSelectedNotLoaded: Model selected but not ready yet. Use Download and load model.
Settings.DownloadActionDescription: Downloads the selected model if it is not on this computer yet, verifies it and loads it. An interrupted download resumes.
Settings.Error: The model could not be prepared: {0}
Manifest.Name: Gemma 4 (Local)
Manifest.Description: Run Google Gemma 4 locally on the CPU with llama.cpp
